The statue of Our Lady of Guadalupe will be moved to the
link area between the church and Carroll Hall. The statue
has some cracks and is in need of restoration. As this
statue was not manufactured for outdoor placement, the
need for repainting and repairs has been costly. The statue
will therefore be protected from the elements and better
preserved inside.

Priests for Life have requested that the following very
comprehensive resource be included in church bulletins -
Heartbeat's OptionLine.org, or its 24-hour emergency
helpline 800-712-HELP (4357) where callers are connected
to the help available close to where they live. Confidential
guidance is offered in English and in Spanish, and many of
these centers also have healing programs for those hurting
from abortion.

Wyoming Catholic Men’s Retreat (August 23rd-
25<sup>th</sup> 2019): The Wyoming Catholic Men’s Retreat is an
opportunity to get away from all the stress of the outside
world and enjoy all that God has to offer. This retreat
concentrates on fellowship, music, and most importantly
growing in your faith. This year's speaker is Deacon Ralph
Poyo! He is the founder of New Evangelization Ministries
Inc. (NEM), Deacon Ralph Poyo seeks to be a useful tool
or assessing Bishops and Pastors in training their
leadership in the processes of Evangelization and
Discipleship. He has traveled extensively around the
United States, serving as an evangelist, popular conference
speaker and consultant. He incorporates what he learned
and experienced in over thirty years of parish and
consulting ministry to rural, inner city, and suburban
parishes and dioceses. This year's speaker is Deacon Ralph
Poyo! We hope you will join us on August 23rd-25th, 2019
in Casper Wyoming at St. Patrick’s Catholic Church
Commons! More
information at:<u>https://www.facebook.com/pg/CatholicMen
[sRetreat](https://www.facebook.com/pg/CatholicMensRetreat)</u>. Register at: <u>[https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2019-
wyoming-catholic-mens-retreat-tickets-58303091115](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2019-wyoming-catholic-mens-retreat-tickets-58303091115)</u>

## <b>Pilgrimage Trip to Italy with Bishop Steven
Biegler and Father Carl Gallinger</b>

<b>February 6-16, 2020.</b> Join Bishop Steven Biegler and
Father Carl Gallinger on this wonderful spiritual journey to
Florence, Assisi, Orvieto, and Rome. Besides having daily
Mass in some of the most beautiful and important basilicas
in Italy, you will also be attending the papal audience with
Pope Francis and seeing many of the sites and monuments
which Italy is famous for, as well as enjoying good Italian
food and wine! Total package $3,600 (minimum 30
people) – Deadline to register is August 16, 2019. For more
information or to register visit:
<u>[www.dioceseofcheyenne.org/italy.html](http://www.dioceseofcheyenne.org/italy.html)</u> or contact Dorene
McIntyre at <u>[dmcintyre@dioceseofcheyenne.org](mailto:dmcintyre@dioceseofcheyenne.org)</u> or (307)
638-1530.
